title: 「It is worth noting that 句：指出值得留意的重點」
titleZh: 「It is worth noting that 句：指出值得留意的重點」
titleEn: Using “It is worth noting that” to highlight an important point

source.file: Sentence Structure 274 -「It is worth noting that 句：指出值得留意的重點」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 274; it is assigned system ID ss275 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: It + is + worth + noting + that + complete clause

formulas.formula: It is worth noting that + clause
However / In addition, + it is worth noting that + clause
Introductory phrase, + it is worth noting that + clause
Main clause, but it is worth noting that + clause
Main sentence. It is worth noting that + clause

example: It is worth noting that the two groups started at different levels.
exampleZh: 值得注意的是，兩組的起點不同。

examples.en: It is worth noting that the two groups started at different levels.
examples.zh: 值得注意的是，兩組的起點不同。
examples.highlight: It is worth noting that the two groups started at different levels.

meaning.zh: 這個句型帶出容易被忽略但值得留意的重要資料、限制、比較差異、特殊情況或決定前應考慮的提醒。

rules.zh: 核心固定句型是： It is worth noting that + clause Example: It is worth noting that the museum closes early on Fridays. （值得注意的是，博物館逢星期五會提早關門。） 句中的核心表達只有： It is worth noting that However、In addition、Before comparing the figures、but 等成分只是可選延伸，並不是固定句型 的一部分。 Compare: It is worth noting that the museum closes early on Fridays. However, it is worth noting that the museum closes early on Fridays. Before planning your visit, it is worth noting that the museum closes early on Fridays. The museum is open at weekends, but it is worth noting that it closes early on Fridays. 以上四句都使用相同的核心句型。
rules.en: The fixed core is It is worth noting that + clause. Connectors and introductory phrases are optional extensions rather than part of the core.

rules.zh: 後面必須接完整子句 That 後面需要有自己的主語和動詞。 Correct: It is worth noting that the two groups started at different levels. ● subject：the two groups ● verb：started Incorrect: It is worth noting that the different starting levels. 這只是名詞詞組，並不是完整子句。 可以改為： It is worth noting that the groups had different starting levels. （值得注意的是，各組的起點不同。）
rules.en: That must be followed by a complete clause with its own subject and verb, not merely a noun phrase.

rules.zh: 後面使用 V-ing 在這個句型中，worth 後面必須使用： noting Correct: It is worth noting that the figures are incomplete. Incorrect: It is worth note that the figures are incomplete. It is worth to note that the figures are incomplete.
rules.en: Use the -ing form noting after worth, not note or to note.

rules.zh: 是形式主語 句首的 it 並不是指某件物件、動物或人物。 它是一個形式主語，讓真正要表達的資料放在 that 子句中。 It is worth noting that the price has increased. 真正值得留意的內容是： the price has increased 而不是 it。
rules.en: It is a formal subject; the information that deserves attention is contained in the that-clause.

rules.zh: 這個句型可以放在句子的不同位置 A. 放在整句開頭 It is worth noting that the two groups started at different levels. （值得注意的是，兩組的起點不同。） B. 放在連接詞後面 However, it is worth noting that the two groups started at different levels. （然而，值得注意的是，兩組的起點不同。） C. 放在前置片語或子句後面 When comparing the results, it is worth noting that the two groups started at different levels. （比較結果時，值得注意的是，兩組的起點不同。） D. 放在 but 後面 The second group achieved a higher final score, but it is worth noting that it also started at a higher level. （第二組的最終分數較高，但值得注意的是，它的起點也較高。） E. 放在第二句 The second group achieved a higher final score. It is worth noting that it also started at a higher level. （第二組的最終分數較高。值得注意的是，它的起點也較高。） 這些位置都自然正確。學生不應把這個句型當作只能放在整段或整句開頭的固定開場白。
rules.en: The structure can begin a sentence, follow a connector or introductory phrase, appear after but, or form a separate second sentence.

rules.zh: 這個句型通常用來加入重要資料、限制或提醒 它常用於指出： ● 容易被忽略的重要事實； ● 可能影響結論的資料； ● 一項比較中的重要差異； ● 一項計劃的限制； ● 一個結果背後的特殊情況； ● 讀者在作決定前應考慮的資料。 Example: Sales increased by 10%. However, it is worth noting that costs also rose. （銷售額上升了百分之十。然而，值得注意的是，成本亦有所增加。） 第二句提醒讀者不要只看銷售額上升，還要考慮成本。
rules.en: Use the structure to add an important fact, limitation, comparison, reminder or special circumstance that can affect interpretation or a decision.

rules.zh: 可選連接詞並非固定句型的一部分 以下字詞可以幫助句子連接前文，但並非必須使用： ● However, ● In addition, ● Nevertheless, ● Before deciding, ● When comparing the figures, ● For new students, ● Although... ● ..., but... Example: It is worth noting that the service is unavailable on Sundays. However, it is worth noting that the service is unavailable on Sundays. For weekend travellers, it is worth noting that the service is unavailable on Sundays. 三句在文法上都完整。後兩句只增加了語境或連接作用。
rules.en: Connectors such as however, in addition and nevertheless, and phrases such as before deciding, are optional context and not part of the fixed form.

rules.zh: 不要加入沒有根據的評價 It is worth noting that 表示某項資料值得讀者注意，但不代表該資料一定： ● 很好； ● 很壞； ● 令人震驚； ● 證明某個結論； ● 比其他資料更重要。 Example: It is worth noting that ten participants left the study early. （值得注意的是，有十名參加者提早退出研究。） 這句只指出資料值得注意，並沒有自行解釋他們為甚麼離開，或研究是否因此無效。 Similar Structures 相似句型辨析 1. It is worth noting that + clause 意思是： 「值得注意的是……」 它用來帶出一項值得留意的完整資料。 Example: It is worth noting that the two surveys used different questions. （值得注意的是，兩項調查使用了不同的問題。） 結構： It is worth noting that + subject + verb 2. Subject + be worth + V-ing 意思是： 「某事值得被做」 這裏的主語是真正值得進行某項行動的人或事物。 Example: This book is worth reading. （這本書值得閱讀。） The issue is worth discussing. （這個問題值得討論。） 結構： Subject + be worth + V-ing Compare: This point is worth noting. （這一點值得注意。） It is worth noting that the two groups started at different levels. （值得注意的是，兩組的起點不同。） 第一句以 this point 為真正主語；第二句使用形式主語 it，並以 that 子句交代完整資料。 3. Note that + clause Note that 是較直接的指示，意思接近： 「請注意……」 Example: Note that the library closes at six. （請注意，圖書館六時關門。） It is worth noting that the library closes at six. （值得注意的是，圖書館六時關門。） Note that 語氣較直接，像是提醒或指示讀者。 It is worth noting that 語氣較婉轉，表示這項資料值得納入考慮。 4. It should be noted that + clause 意思同樣接近「應注意的是……」，但語氣通常較正式和客觀。 Example: It should be noted that the results are preliminary. （應注意的是，這些結果只是初步結果。） It is worth noting that the results are preliminary. （值得注意的是，這些結果只是初步結果。） It should be noted that 較像正式報告中的客觀提示。 It is worth noting that 則較自然地表示作者認為這項資料值得讀者留意。 5. It is important to note that + clause 這個句型比 It is worth noting that 語氣更強。 Compare: It is worth noting that several participants arrived late. （值得注意的是，有數名參加者遲到。） It is important to note that several participants arrived late. （必須注意的是，有數名參加者遲到。） worth noting 表示資料值得留意。 important to note 更明確地表示資料十分重要。 不要在改寫時隨意把原句的語氣加強。 Best Core Grammar Bank 核心句型庫 1. 作為完整句子的開首 It is worth noting that + clause. It is worth noting that the two groups started at different levels. （值得注意的是，兩組的起點不同。） 2. 放在連接詞後面 However / In addition, + it is worth noting that + clause. However, it is worth noting that the sample was quite small. （然而，值得注意的是，樣本相當小。） In addition, it is worth noting that the service is free. （此外，值得注意的是，這項服務是免費的。） 連接詞可以刪除： It is worth noting that the sample was quite small. 句子仍然完整。 3. 放在前置片語後面 Introductory phrase, + it is worth noting that + clause. When comparing the two plans, it is worth noting that only one includes insurance. （比較兩個計劃時，值得注意的是，只有其中一個包括保險。） Before making a decision, it is worth noting that the fee cannot be refunded. （作決定之前，值得注意的是，費用不能退還。） 前置片語只是交代在甚麼情況下應留意該資料。 4. 放在 although 子句後面 Although + clause, + it is worth noting that + clause. Although the course is free, it is worth noting that places are limited. （雖然課程免費，但值得注意的是，名額有限。） 這種結構能先承認一項正面或負面資料，再補充一項重要限制。 5. 放在 but 後面 Main clause, but it is worth noting that + clause. The total number increased, but it is worth noting that one category declined. （總數有所增加，但值得注意的是，其中一個類別有所下降。） 這個結構特別適合修正過於簡單或片面的結論。 6. 作為第二句 Main sentence. It is worth noting that + clause. The team finished the project early. It is worth noting that two members were absent. （團隊提早完成項目。值得注意的是，當時有兩名成員缺席。） 這個結構讓作者先提出主要結果，再補充值得留意的背景。 7. 指定某類讀者或情況 For + person/group, + it is worth noting that + clause. For new members, it is worth noting that the club closes during August. （對新會員而言，值得注意的是，會所於八月暫停開放。） For drivers, it is worth noting that the road becomes narrow after the bridge. （對駕駛者而言，值得注意的是，道路在橋後會變窄。） For + person/group 只是指出這項資料對誰特別有用。
rules.en: Do not add an unsupported evaluation. The structure says that information deserves attention, not that it is necessarily good, bad, shocking or conclusive; keep its strength distinct from related forms such as note that, it should be noted that and it is important to note that.

benefits.zh: 幫助讀者留意容易忽略的資料 這個句型可以把一項重要但不明顯的資料突出出來。 Example: The hotel is close to the beach. It is worth noting that the path is very steep. （酒店鄰近海灘。值得注意的是，通往海灘的小徑十分陡峭。） 讀者不會只看到「鄰近海灘」這項優點，也會注意實際前往海灘可能有困難。
benefits.en: It helps readers notice important information that could easily be overlooked.

benefits.zh: 避免作出過於簡單的結論 當數據或情況看來十分清楚時，這個句型可以加入限制或背景資料。 Compare: Sales increased, so the company performed well. Sales increased, but it is worth noting that costs increased as well. 第二句讓分析更全面，不會只根據單一數字下結論。
benefits.en: It prevents oversimplified conclusions by adding relevant limitations or background information.

benefits.zh: 令比較更公平準確 比較兩組數據、產品、計劃或人物時，它可以提醒讀者注意兩者原本存在的差異。 Example: The second group achieved a higher final score. However, it is worth noting that it also started at a higher level. （第二組取得較高的最終分數。然而，值得注意的是，它的起點也較高。） 這能避免讀者把最終分數的差異完全當作進步幅度的差異。
benefits.en: It makes comparisons fairer and more accurate by drawing attention to important starting differences or conditions.

benefits.zh: 自然加入補充資料 你不需要另寫： ● Another important thing is... ● We must remember... ● Do not forget... ● One fact that deserves attention is... 你可以使用 It is worth noting that，把補充資料自然地接在主要內容後面。
benefits.en: It adds supplementary information naturally without awkward phrases such as “Another important thing is ...”.

benefits.zh: 適合報告、作文、簡報和數據分析 這個句型特別適合： ● 比較圖表； ● 分析調查結果； ● 評估計劃； ● 討論優點和缺點； ● 提出較平衡的意見； ● 解釋研究限制； ● 提醒聽眾注意實際安排。 它能令分析聽起來較慎重和有條理。
benefits.en: It is useful in reports, essays, presentations and data analysis for balanced evaluation, limitations and practical reminders.

benefits.zh: 讓句子位置更多變 It is worth noting that 不必每次都放在答案開頭。 你可以寫： It is worth noting that... However, it is worth noting that... When comparing the figures, it is worth noting that... The figure increased, but it is worth noting that... The figure increased. It is worth noting that... 這種位置變化可以避免多句連續使用完全相同的開首。
benefits.en: It increases sentence-position variety because the structure can appear initially, after context, after but or as a separate second sentence.

en: Rewrite each sentence using it is worth noting that.
Place the target at the beginning, after an introductory phrase, after but or in a separate second sentence as required; preserve all important information and follow the supplied first word.
zh: 使用 it is worth noting that 改寫每題。
按需要把目標句型放在句首、前置片語後、but 後或獨立第二句；保留所有重要資料，並按照已提供的第一個字作答。
